title: Forearm Specialization
author: Mithosphere
desc:
As with the rest of the body, forearms like a variety of exercises, but like everything else there are some very good movements, and some movements which are simply a waste of time. So we are only interested in the very best result producing movements.

The forearms can take a lot of work so we can work them at least four days a week. Don't worry though, these will be very fast, short workouts that should not take longer than about 30 minutes to complete. Take the first week to get familiar with the routine and then go all out. With forearms training, you can go quite a ways past what you think is your limit.

Training for the Rest of Your Body
It goes without saying that the rest of the body should not be neglected during a period of forearm specialization. In fact, you can still train fairly hard, because forearm training is not that energy draining.

Mondays & Thursday
1. Barbell Preacher Curl (EZ Bar) 5x10
Although the preacher curl is primarily a bicep exercise, it is also a very good upper forearm developer, and an ideal exercise to begin your routine with.
Warm-up at 70% for best 10RM, then increase weight and go all out to get 10 reps. Resting only 30-40 seconds, do another 3 sets using the same weight for AMRAP.
2. Reverse Preacher Curl (EZ Bar) 6x12 superset with Seated Wrist Curl 6x15
Thumbs around bar on preacher curl, thumbs under bar on wrist curl. Squeeze at top of wrist curl. Rest only seconds between supersets. Treat last 4 sets as AMRAP.
3. One Arm Wrist Curl (Dumbbell) 4x12
Sit on box/bench, rest arm along top of thigh. Use a 12RM weight and go for AMRAP for 4 sets.

Tuesday & Friday
1. Leg Raises 2x25 superset with Sit Ups 2x25
2. Squat (Barbell)
1x12 at 75% of 12RM, then increase weight to 12RM for AMRAP. Reduce weight 20-40 lbs and do another AMRAP set.
3. Calf Raise 3x20
30 seconds rest between sets
4. Low Incline Bench Press (Dumbbell) 4x10
30 degree incline. Warm-up 1x10 with 20 lbs lighter than 10RM, then add weight and do 3x10RM for AMRAP.
5. Chin-Up 3x10
3" grip outside of shoulders. Warm-up bodyweight only, then add weight for 8-10RM to failure. Last set bodyweight only 1x10.
6. Seated OHP (Barbell) 3x10
Warm-up at 75% of 10RM 1x10, then add weight for 10RM 1 x10, short rest, reduce weight 10 lbs last to failure.
7. Barbell Curl 3x8 superset with Dips 3x8
Warm-up, then 2x8 supersets for max weight.

Wednesday & Saturday
1. Preacher Curl (Dumbbell) 5x8
Same as barbell version.
2. Seated Wrist Curl 4x15 superset with Reverse Wrist Curl 4x15
Same as Monday/Friday, slight decline, minus false grip and let bar roll to fingertips. Reverse Wrist Curl, 6" hand spacing, squeeze 2 seconds at top.
3. Reverse Curl (EZ Bar) 5x10
Hold 3" outside thigs. Slow eccentric, reduce by 5 lbs each set.

Be as progressive as you can during each workout, and try to do more reps, add more weight, contract harder, concentrate more strongly.
